name: What causes mold to grow on a ceiling?

mainEntity.name: What causes mold to grow on a ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mold growth on ceilings is primarily caused by excess moisture. This can stem from various sources, including a leaky roof, plumbing issues in an upstairs bathroom or attic, condensation from poor ventilation, or high humidity levels within the home. Even small, undetected leaks can create an ideal environment for mold to flourish over time. Identifying and repairing the moisture source is the first step to preventing recurrence.
acceptedAnswer.description: Mold on ceilings is caused by excess moisture from leaks, poor ventilation, or high humidity. Finding and fixing the moisture source is key.
